asteroid/programs/beyond_one_not.ath exits 0 with and without Lean: 23 claims true, 4 kernel theorems (3 restated in the project's definitions), 5 hunts of 6 s at t <= 2, 3 with no counterexample

S3 (rank 1) FlipClasses.count t: a correct circuit with at most t NOT gates has at least base flip classes; by the per-set lemma this is a statement about classes shared between sets only (Hall form). Implies BoolSumNot t. First step: the per-set lemma in Lean

S5 (rank 2) Worlds.worldBound is provable for every t from rung 0 but weak (below n at t = 1 on designs, 0 at t = ceil(log2(n+1))); open: the t-world certificate game, a count of merge gates across the 2^t faces
S1 (rank 3) BoolSumNot 2: two NOT gates save nothing. Exact on five small systems for any number of NOT gates; a proof needs rung 1 (no_minCE) closed first

S2 (rank 4) BoolSumNotFree t: #AND/OR gates >= base with NOT gates free (conjectured savings f(t) = 0; tight at t = 3). An accounting losing a factor 2^t is superlinear on designs only for t < (1/2) log2 n

S4 (rank 5) BoolSumNotLog: rung ceil(log2(n+1)) on projective planes would give (base - n - 2)/2 gates for ALL circuits (above 3.1 n from q = 8); not expected from this route without a new idea; may be false
